about.title: Engineering the Void
about.lead: I do not see software as disjointed blocks of code, but as living infrastructure where data fidelity and human workflows intersect.
about.p1: My technical path began by understanding how data flows at the OS kernel and network levels, evolving into end-to-end enterprise solution delivery: from high-concurrency backend microservices and transactional gateways, to reactive mobile field apps for frontline technicians.
about.p2: I specialize in untangling legacy systems or messy manual workflows and refactoring them with clean architectures, Zero Trust security boundaries, and automated pipelines that eradicate operational friction.
